package generators

import (
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "strings"
    "testing"
)

func TestHostedOpenWrtProcdAgent(t *testing.T) {
    root := t.TempDir()
    for _, dir := range []string{"etc/init.d", "etc/rc.d", "usr/local/sbin"} {
        if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, dir), 0755); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    }
    generator := &lxdAgent{}
    generator.sourceDir = root
    if err := generator.handleProcd(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    for _, name := range []string{"S05lxd-agent", "K85lxd-agent"} {
        target, err := os.Readlink(filepath.Join(root, "etc/rc.d", name))
        if err != nil || target != "/etc/init.d/lxd-agent" { t.Fatalf("invalid agent lifecycle link: %s %v", target, err) }
    }
    for _, name := range []string{"etc/init.d/lxd-agent", "usr/local/sbin/lxd-agent-wrapper", "usr/local/sbin/lxd-agent-setup"} {
        info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(root, name))
        if err != nil || info.Mode().Perm() != 0755 { t.Fatalf("agent script missing or not executable: %s %v", name, err) }
    }
    wrapper, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "usr/local/sbin/lxd-agent-wrapper"))
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if !strings.Contains(string(wrapper), "exec /run/lxd_agent/lxd-agent") { t.Fatal("wrapper does not launch the native LXD agent") }
    setup, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "usr/local/sbin/lxd-agent-setup"))
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if string(setup) != lxdAgentSetupScript { t.Fatal("procd changed the vendor config-drive setup") }
}
